summary: Preserve Node error-first callback and event-loop/threadpool completion semantics for fs.readFile.

semantics.success: err is null; data is Buffer or string according to encoding
semantics.ordering: completion order relative to other async fs operations is not guaranteed

caveats: Invoking the callback synchronously is incorrect.
Mapping directly to Task.Run without the JS event-loop bridge can change callback ordering and exception behavior.
Missing/invalid callback itself can throw synchronously before I/O starts.

tests.name: callback is asynchronous
tests.expected_behavior: callback is not invoked inline; it observes subsequent synchronous assignment under normal completion

tests.name: error-first missing file
tests.expected_behavior: callback receives an error and no successful data value according to Node callback conventions
